hook: 84% survival rate when oral cancer is caught early. That number drops sharply once it spreads.
caption: 84% of people diagnosed with oral cancer in its earliest stage survive it. By the time it reaches a later stage, that survival rate can fall below 40%. The gap between those two numbers isn't about luck, it's about timing. Most early-stage cases don't cause pain, which means people aren't rushing to get checked, and a lot of cases get found late as a result. A quick, free risk screener can't replace a clinical exam, but it can tell you whether you're carrying risk factors worth talking to a dentist or doctor about. Takes about two minutes. Take it at oralcheck.org.
